arStrings.szText: I found a tavern! Got myself swept into some sort of wedding here in...Goolron? Gu-Gulran? Oh, such a lively place, I must learn how to spell it!
The moment these folk saw me, they placed a crown of wheat on my head and pulled me in off the street. (chuckles) Seems that they don’t get too many westerners, so I’m something of a celebrity!
They sat me down beside another foreign fellow. Big bear of a man called “Vasily.” I cheekily asked if he was the ancient father of the Druids, and he laughed himself pink! (laughs)
Oh dear, he’s shouting at me to shut my damn book! Wants to show me how to drink like a “true sailor of the ‘Glen.” Very well then! Ahem— For Tristram! (chuckles)
